meaning.zh:
“保持头脑清醒” 或 “保持警惕”。

这个短语起源于 16 世纪，当时 “wit” 指的是智力或聪明才智。短语 “Keep your wits about you” 被用来提醒人们在危险或复杂的情况下要保持冷静和清醒，以便做出明智的决策。在现代社会，这个短语被用来提醒人们在面对困难或紧急情况时，要保持头脑冷静，不慌张。
meaning.en: This phrase originated in the 16th century when "wit" referred to intellect or cleverness. "Keep your wits about you" was used to remind people to stay calm and alert in dangerous or complex situations in order to make wise decisions. In modern times, the phrase is used to remind individuals to stay composed and aware when facing difficult or urgent circumstances.

lines.en: When walking through a crowded market, you need to *keep your wits about you*.
lines.zh: 走在拥挤的市场时，你需要保持头脑清醒。

lines.en: During the negotiation, you must *keep your wits about you* to get the best deal.
lines.zh: 在谈判过程中，你必须保持头脑清醒，才能争取到最好的交易。

lines.en: Drivers need to *keep their wits about them* on icy roads.
lines.zh: 司机在结冰的路面上需要保持警惕。
